company_specific_kpis.commentary: Automotive gross margin excluding zero-emission regulatory credits snapped back significantly from 14.6% in Q2 2026 to 17.05% in Q3 2026, driven by lower cost of goods sold per vehicle ($34,100) and higher Model 3/Y production density in Austin and Berlin.
company_specific_kpis.tooltip: Automotive Gross Margin ex-Regulatory Credits: The pure profitability of vehicle manufacturing, subtracting 100% margin regulatory credit sales to assess true underlying unit economics.

company_specific_kpis.commentary: Delivered 486,532 vehicles globally (478,237 Model 3/Y and 8,295 Other Models), exceeding both Wall Street consensus and buy-side whisper numbers with order backlog reaching a 4-year high.
company_specific_kpis.tooltip: Total Vehicle Deliveries: The exact count of customer deliveries recognized during the 3-month reporting period under GAAP revenue recognition criteria.

company_specific_kpis.commentary: Deployed a record 13.7 GWh of Megapack and Powerwall utility-scale energy storage, driven by surging AI data center backup power demand and initial shipments from Megafactory Texas.
company_specific_kpis.tooltip: Energy Storage Deployment (GWh): Gigawatt-hours of utility-scale Megapacks and residential Powerwalls installed and connected to commercial or residential grids.

company_specific_kpis.commentary: Active Full Self-Driving (Supervised & Unsupervised) paying subscriber base expanded by +260k sequentially to 1.74M users, boosting deferred revenue recognition to $1,255M in Q3.
company_specific_kpis.tooltip: Active FSD Subscriptions: Cumulative count of active monthly recurring subscriptions and recognized upfront software purchases for Tesla's Full Self-Driving neural network suite.

company_specific_kpis.commentary: Regulatory credit sales plummeted to $417M from $890M in Q2 2026. Because credits carry near 100% gross margin, this makes the total gross profit beat ($5,494M) exceptionally high quality.
company_specific_kpis.tooltip: Automotive Regulatory Credits: Pure-profit carbon offset credits sold to legacy OEM automakers who fail to meet government clean air fleet emission mandates.
